title: Remove the middle IT company or companies
description:
Remove the middle IT company or companies from the list.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as remove_middle_companies(companies), returning a new list with the middle item removed (odd length) or the two middle items removed (even length).
hints: This mirrors slicing out the middle item(s), but you keep everything except that slice.
Concatenate the part before the middle with the part after the middle.
Use mid = len(companies) // 2; for odd n return companies[:mid] + companies[mid + 1:], for even n return companies[:mid - 1] + companies[mid + 1:].
expected_behavior: Returns a new list with the middle item (odd length) or two middle items (even length) removed.
explanation: Concatenating the slice before the middle with the slice after it removes exactly the middle item(s), matching the odd/even split used to find them.
